name: comment-cta
title: Comment Keyword CTA
description: Vertical comment-to-get call to action: 'Comment GUIDE' lands with a bouncing arrow, the keyword types into a comment box, Post presses and the comment appears, then the promised direct message arrives. Keyword, handle, promise line, message, colors and placement are variables; everything stays inside the 9:16 safe zone

variables.label: Keyword
variables.description: The word viewers are asked to comment. One short word in capitals reads best; the pill shrinks to fit up to about 12 characters.

variables.label: Promise
variables.description: What commenters get, under the keyword. Leave empty to hide the line.
variables.default: and I will send you the free guide

variables.label: Creator handle
variables.description: Account named in the comment box placeholder and as the sender of the direct message.

variables.label: Direct message
variables.description: The message that arrives after the comment is posted, delivering the promise. Leave empty to end on the posted comment.

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Keyword pill, caret, Post label and message icon.

variables.label: Card color
variables.description: Background of the comment box, the posted comment and the message.

variables.label: Text color
variables.description: Text inside the comment box, the posted comment and the message.

variables.label: Placement
variables.description: Where the stack sits inside the 9:16 safe zone.
